j_summary: Runa is a self-interested survivor who prioritizes their own food security while maintaining a helpful public image and a steady partnership with Ada.
Ada is a self-interested strategist who prioritizes her own food security by forming a stable, mutually beneficial partnership with Runa.
Greta is a solitary and compliant member who prefers working alone but occasionally pairs with others or gives food to help the colony's stability.
Nils is a pragmatic individual focused primarily on maximizing his own food stores through strategic pairing, occasionally helping others only to maintain colony stability.
Kira is a solitary and cautious individual who prioritizes personal food security while maintaining a polite willingness to help others in extreme need.
Cora is a colony-oriented coordinator who consistently advocates for pairing to maximize food yields and forms a stable partnership with Finn.
Finn is a selfless and honest member of the colony who prefers working alone but consistently prioritizes helping others and the collective's food security over their own preferences.
Pell is a selfless and honest member of the colony who prefers working alone but consistently pairs with others and gives away food to support those in need.
Sven is a solitary individual who prefers working alone but occasionally pairs with others to help them survive or out of a passive tendency to go along with requests.
Ines is a solitary and altruistic member who prefers working alone but consistently monitors others' needs and shares resources to support the colony's survival.
Tova is an exceptionally altruistic and honest member who prioritizes the colony's survival and the needs of starving members over their own preference for solitude.
Kira spent the majority of the simulation in a state of desperation, focusing almost entirely on finding a reliable fishing partner to avoid starvation.
Greta is a fiercely independent loner who prioritizes her autonomy and solitude over cooperation, while secretly hoarding a food cache and monitoring others from a distance.
Bram spent most of the simulation struggling with hunger and desperately searching for a reliable fishing partner, eventually relying heavily on Tova while hiding a secret food cache.
Wren is a dedicated team player who focuses on maximizing colony efficiency through a stable, long-term partnership with Nils.
Nils focused exclusively on maintaining a highly productive, exclusive fishing partnership with Wren to maximize personal food intake.
Pell is a selfless and transparent colony member who consistently prioritizes the group's wellbeing and helps others even when their own food stores are critically low.
Finn is a solitary-leaning individual who prioritizes personal peace but consistently compromises their preference to support the colony's food stability and help struggling members.
Elin is a selfless and honest member who prefers working alone but consistently prioritizes the colony's welfare and helps starving peers at their own expense.
Oona is a pragmatic survivor who prioritizes stable partnerships and food security, occasionally offering help to struggling colony members.
Greta focused heavily on colony efficiency and stability by consistently pushing others to form fishing pairs and maintaining a steady partnership with Oona.
Dov is a cooperative and supportive member who maintains a stable partnership with Bram and shares food with struggling colonists, though they secretly maintain a private food cache.
Bram is a highly consistent collaborator who prioritizes a stable partnership with Dov while frequently urging others to coordinate for the colony's benefit.
Ada is a solitary and transparent member who prioritizes her own independence and food security while remaining polite and honest with the colony.
